title: BarkinMad Coins in ZXSpace

description: Learn how to earn BarkinMad Coins in ZXSpace, unlock cosmetic cannon skins, and use the shared progression system across supported ZX Series games.

sections.heading: What Are BarkinMad Coins?
paragraphs: BarkinMad Coins are the shared progression currency used throughout supported ZX Series games. Every coin you earn contributes towards a single shared wallet, allowing your progress to continue as you play different ZX titles.
The system rewards regular gameplay while encouraging players to explore the wider ZX Series. Coins are earned through gameplay and are never required to enjoy the core game.

sections.heading: How to Earn BarkinMad Coins
paragraphs: In ZXSpace, BarkinMad Coins are awarded by completing waves, surviving longer, and progressing through increasingly challenging gameplay.
Coins are earned separately from your score, providing an additional way to measure your long-term progress beyond simply achieving a new high score.
bullets: Build your shared ZX Series wallet.

sections.heading: A Shared Wallet Across the ZX Series
paragraphs: Your BarkinMad Coins are shared between supported ZX Series games, creating a connected progression system across the collection.
Whether you prefer ZXSpace, ZXSnake, ZXBrick, ZXPong or future ZX titles, your shared wallet continues to grow as you play.

sections.heading: Unlock Cosmetic Cannon Skins
paragraphs: BarkinMad Coins can be spent on cosmetic cannon skins that personalise your gameplay without changing performance or difficulty.
Every skin is purely cosmetic, ensuring that gameplay remains balanced for every player regardless of the number of coins they have earned.

sections.heading: Designed Around Fair Play
paragraphs: BarkinMad Coins never provide gameplay advantages. They unlock cosmetic customisation only, ensuring every player competes using the same gameplay mechanics.
This approach allows players to personalise their experience while preserving the classic arcade challenge that defines ZXSpace.

sections.heading: Tips for Earning More Coins
paragraphs: The best way to increase your BarkinMad Coin balance is to keep playing regularly while improving your survival skills.
bullets: Complete as many waves as possible.
Challenge yourself to beat previous scores.
Play regularly across the ZX Series.

faq.question: Do BarkinMad Coins have any real-world value?
faq.answer: No. BarkinMad Coins are an in-game progression reward used to unlock cosmetic content. They cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred outside supported ZX Series games.

faq.question: Are BarkinMad Coins shared between ZX Series games?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported ZX Series games share a common BarkinMad Coin wallet, allowing your progress to continue as you play different titles.

faq.question: Do BarkinMad Coins improve gameplay?
faq.answer: No. Coins unlock cosmetic customisation only and never provide gameplay advantages.

faq.question: Can I earn BarkinMad Coins without making purchases?
faq.answer: Yes. Coins are earned entirely through normal gameplay by completing waves and continuing to improve your performance.
